Could you please explain - what does it means "Long is fantastic" compared to stock ACC?
Is it absolutely better than stock or just usable?

Stock ACC is going to be different depending on what car you have.

For my car stock ACC is great on the highway but not very usable in town because it doesn’t have any awareness of stoplights/signs and will return to the set cruise control speed regardless of the environment. 

The positive with stock Acc is that it uses radar so will always see a lead car just not super far away.

OP long, in this case for the model SLv2, appears to have fantastic lead tracking at a distance as well as for cars entering and leaving the lane. It applies brakes early enough to react to stopped cars at stoplights even if I am traveling ~45mph, it will stop without me having to intervene. 

It also does very well at following a car at very slow speeds without stopping.

It’s stoplight/stopsign awareness is decent, and it does take into account the road to some degree and doesnt mat the throttle like stock Acc would if the curve is high.

So for me this is better than stock because it allows me to keep sunnypilot engaged for far more do the drive than I previously would. It’s not perfect, but it’s a big step in the right direction.

Simple plan and DTRv5 were also great for long. However I have not had a model succeed at slowing down behind a stopped car like this model so I’ll be running it for a while to see if there are other quirks.
